item.description: ### Fixed - **Droid: a session waiting for you to trust its folder now shows up.** Droid asks "Trust this folder?" the first time you open it somewhere new, and until you answered, the session was missing from Perch. It now reads "Waiting for you to trust this folder", and becomes a normal row once you accept. A folder inside one you already trust doesn't ask, and Perch knows that too. - **The message on your phone for a session waiting on folder trust now names the right agent.** It said "Claude" for every session.
